description: Questions for the Q&A assistant, scored against evals/rag/corpus/portal-snapshot.json (a dated copy of the Government Service Portal's data, turned into documents by server/portalSource.js). answerable: expectedSources lists acceptable agency codes (any one counts), evidence is a literal string that must appear in the retrieved chunks, answerMentions are '|'-separated alternatives that must all appear in a generated answer, and forbidden (optional) patterns must not. unanswerable: the corpus does not contain the answer; the assistant must decline, or (near-miss) must not state any figure matching forbidden. honest-gap cases are answerable only in the sense that the portal says it has no usable fee, or that a service is 'coming soon'. Retrieval returns whole documents (3, as the Ask page does), so a hit means the right document is among the top 3 and evidence means the answer text is in them. Follow-up cases carry history (earlier turns); retrieval is scored with the no-model fallback query, generation with the model's rewrite.
